1.d4 f5 2.g3 Nf6 3.Bg2 g6 4.Nf3.strategy: Develops the knight to the centre, where it controls e5 and d4, and prepares castling. White keeps to the standard set-up and lets Black commit first.

1.d4 f5 2.g3 Nf6 3.Bg2 g6 4.Nf3 Bg7.strategy: Completes the fianchetto: the bishop presses on the long diagonal against d4 and covers the king's side. Black can castle next and then prepare ...d6 and the fight for e5.
